title: Job Search Engine search profile
description: Everything personal about what a good job means for one person. Written by an AI assistant after a short interview, not by hand.

name.description: Free text label for the profile.

titles.description: Job titles you look for. A posting passes when its title contains one of them (case-insensitive).

exclude_title_words.description: Words that drop a title: seniority you do not want, other fields.

spoken.description: Languages you work in. A language NOT listed that appears in a job title (for example 'German speaking') drops the job. Names come from geo/places.json.

home_country.description: Country you live in. Key from geo/places.json, for example 'poland'.

home_extra_places.description: Extra names that mean home: suburbs, regions.

relocation.description: Countries or groups (@eu) you could move to: priority P2.

relocation_secondary.description: Further countries you could move to under extra conditions: also P2.

excluded.description: Countries you never want: dropped everywhere. A row is dropped only when every place in it is excluded.

scoped_out.description: Marker groups of places that scope a remote job away from you. null = derived from the home country's region.

show_p3.description: Show P3 (needs a visa, or the place is in none of your zones). Hidden by default.

exclude.description: Companies you never want, with the reason: {"Name": "reason"}.

boards.description: Job boards to read. Names are listed in catalog/sources.json. Default: dou, djinni.

dou.description: DOU search terms (any term works). null = derived from roles.titles.

djinni.description: Djinni keywords. Only keywords from catalog/sources.json filter the list; unknown ones are rejected. null = derived from roles.titles.

background.description: What you already have, so that an ad demanding it does not count as a blocker.

certificates.description: Certificate families you hold: pmp; pm_certificates (PRINCE2, PM2, AgilePM, IPMA, Scrum...); agile_certificates (SAFe, CSM, PSM...).

domains.description: Industries you have worked in. An ad that REQUIRES a domain you do not list is a wall.

eu_citizen.description: Citizen of an EU country: 'EU citizens only' and 'right to work in the EU' ads do not block you.

avoid_ties.description: Places whose ties in an ad you want to check first.

signals.description: Funding and grant news as consulting or job leads (signals.py). Regions and sectors are set in that file.

replies.description: Read employer replies from your inbox, read-only (replies.py). Needs .env.

assistant.description: Settings for the AI assistant. The engine ignores them.

match_target.description: Percent of the ad's requirements that confirmed facts must cover before a CV is built.

notes.description: Things the profile has no field for: pay floor, relocation conditions, acceptable remote regions, wishes. The assistant reads them.
